 "content": "def transform(grid):
    """Rotate the marked rectangular panel by reflecting across its anti-diagonal."""
    rows = len(grid)
    cols = len(grid[0]) if rows else 0
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(rows) for c in range(cols) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    if not cells:
        return []
    r0 = min(r for r, _ in cells)
    r1 = max(r for r, _ in cells)
    c0 = min(c for _, c in cells)
    c1 = max(c for _, c in cells)
    h, w = r1 - r0 + 1, c1 - c0 + 1
    out = [[0] * h for _ in range(w)]
    for r in range(r0, r1 + 1):
        for c in range(c0, c1 + 1):
            out[w - 1 - (c - c0)][h - 1 - (r - r0)] = grid[r][c]
    return out

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import json, sys
    print(json.dumps(transform(json.load(sys.stdin))))
